title: Qt: Prevent overflow in I/O Graph simple moving average
description:
The warmup_interval, mvag_to_remove, and mavg_to_add variables
are always multiples of the fixed interval, and when retrieving
the item value, we divde by the fixed interval. There's no point
in doing that; just keep track of everything in term of indices.

In particular, this removes the possibility of overflow, which
could occur in 4.4 and later because the interval scaling changed
by a factor of 1000 in order to support intervals down to 1 microsecond.
( b46c1e9fc7ecb5f74c839dfca198e4022b2d2075 )

Also add a failure check if a negative index is passed into
get_io_graph_item instead of running off the left end of an array.

Fix #20163

What is the typical turn around time for when I will see this fix in a future release? Thanks.

Our scheduled Roadmap is located here: https://wiki.wireshark.org/Development/Roadmap

The fix will be in the official release 4.4.2, currently scheduled for November 20.

Automated daily builds are available here: https://www.wireshark.org/download/automated/

Anything which has a version of v4.4.2rc0-30 or later should have the fix. (I'm not sure what platform you're using - there's a minor problem with the MacOS Arm builder at the moment so there's not a daily package including the fix for that, but it should be resolved soon.)
